title: Automated Risk Scoring & Evidence-First Vendor Portal Integration
creator: Asha Kumar
description: Problem: Enterprise procurement is a major friction point for sales and legal: customers repeatedly request SOC2 artifacts, insurer certificates, and contract addenda. Current process is manual (email + Drive links) which is slow, error-prone, and does not scale. Goal: build an evidence-first vendor onboarding flow that surfaces a machine-readable risk score and a curated evidence bundle in a vendor portal so Sales/Legal can share a single canonical link with prospects. This initiative pairs pricing/packaging experiments (insurance cost pass-through and SLA tiers) with procurement automation to reduce time-to-sign and decrease legal review cycles.
success_metrics: Reduce average time from procurement request to evidence delivery from 10 business days to <= 2 business days
Increase close rate on enterprise deals flagged for SOC2 by +8 percentage points within 90 days
Automated evidence coverage >= 85% of typical SOC2 questionnaire requests (based on historical asks)
Pilot insurance-required deals routed with pre-validated certificate info 100% of the time
acceptance_criteria: Risk scoring engine produces a deterministic score (0-100) based on vendor controls, attestations, and insurance limits and is accessible via REST API
Vendor portal exposes a per-tenant evidence bundle link that updates when documents change and contains signed SOC2 summary, encryption/KMS configuration summary, and insurance certificate metadata
Portal link supports object-level access control (signed URL + short TTL) and logs accesses to the audit stream
Legal team has a checklist-driven contract addendum generator for common procurement redlines (data residency, breach notification, audit rights) integrated into portal exports
Integration tests cover upload -> score -> bundle generation -> access log end-to-end and are runnable in CI
tasks: Define the risk-scoring model with Security: weightings for SOC2, encryption, incident history, insurance limits
Design portal wireframes for evidence consumption (Design ticket DES-214) and a lightweight share modal
API spec for evidence bundle and scoring endpoint (ENG owners: runtime & infra teams)
Implement a proof-of-concept connector to our Drive/Confluence store to auto-collect existing artifacts
Pilot workflow with 3 sales accounts and 2 procurement partners (include SLA/insurance pass-through experiment)
Create legal templates for contract addenda and document required review steps
Instrument analytics: time-to-evidence, link opens, downstream effect on MQL->SQL conversion

risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Automated scoring may under- or over-estimate vendor posture leading to customer confusion. Mitigation: surface human review flag and explanation text with links to evidence items.
Risk: Exposing evidence links could leak sensitive config details. Mitigation: redact sensitive fields in portal exports and log all accesses to the audit stream; require signed URLs and short TTLs.
Risk: Legal pushback on pass-through insurance pricing. Mitigation: pilot small cohorts and gather contract-level win/loss feedback before wider rollout.
